svg.aria-label: Jailbreaks: bypassing model safety alignment, and layered defenses
svg.text: Jailbreak: bypass the model's SAFETY training (not the app's instructions)
ROOT CAUSE: helpfulness vs. refusal are two RLHF goals in tension, over one token stream —
a crafted prompt can tip the model from "refuse" to "comply". vs prompt injection = subvert the APP.
many-shot - multi-turn crescendo - GCG/AutoDAN adversarial suffixes - and combinations of these
DEFENSE IN DEPTH (contain, don't perfectly block)
1. hardened safety prompt 2. input guardrail: markers + decode-and-rescreen
3. INDEPENDENT guardrail model (different attack surface) 4. output guardrail (block leaks)
5. least-privilege tools + human-in-the-loop + audit logs -> a jailbreak that gets through can't act
OWASP LLM01:2025 folds jailbreaks under Prompt Injection. Alignment is the provider's job;
app-layer guardrails are yours. Even frontier models stay jailbreakable -> layer your defenses.
